char.base.nick: Balanced benchmark: standard power, speed, reach and endurance.
char.bruno.nick: Durable bruiser: heavy blows, extra fatigue capacity, slow recovery.
char.captain.nick: Mobile burst fighter: quick recovery, costly pressure and lower durability.
char.dragon.nick: Long-range outboxer: extended jab and Cross, slower follow-through.
char.longan.nick: Endurance specialist: efficient pressure and a weak one-star uppercut.
char.marco.nick: Steady all-rounder: stronger Cross, balanced speed and endurance.
char.mia.nick: Agile pressure fighter: fast hands, extra jab fatigue capacity, short reach.
char.nadia.nick: Fast, light Cross pressure with extra fatigue capacity.
char.roxy.nick: Close-range brawler: heavy hooks, costly swings.
char.tee.nick: Fast burst attacker: heavy Cross and hooks, fragile with low stamina.
char.tyke.nick: Precision powerhouse: crushing blows, tires quickly, easily stunned.

A: Dodge · RB/RT: Guard · LB/LT: Uppercut

WASD: Move · J/K/L: Jab/Cross/Hook
I: Uppercut · Space: Dodge · Shift: Guard
input.keyboard_right:

tutorial.anyone_recovering_from_a_punch: Someone recovering from a punch, especially a miss, is Vulnerable and pulses red. Hit the dummy now.
tutorial.cross_text: Cross: slower, heavier, longest reach. {btn} to land 2 crosses.
tutorial.dodge_text: {btn} to slip punches. The stick sets the direction. Avoid 2 punches.
tutorial.everything_is_on_knock_the: Everything is on. Knock the dummy out!
tutorial.green_is_health_hits_that: Green is health. Face hits (inner circle) do full damage, body hits half. Land one of each.
tutorial.guard_text: The dummy attacks now. Hold {btn} to block 3 jabs. Blocking costs stamina, never health.
tutorial.hit_someone_while_they_are: COUNTER (x1.2): hit someone as they start a punch. Beat the dummy's slow cross with a Cross or Hook.
tutorial.hook_text: Hook: heavy swing, shorter reach. Close in and {btn} to land a hook.
tutorial.jab_text: Jab: your fastest, lightest punch. {btn} to land 2 jabs.
tutorial.perfect_guard_text: PERFECT GUARD: raise guard just before a hit (first {perfect} frames). Releasing exposes you {penalty} frames.
tutorial.repeating_one_punch_tires_it: Repeating one punch tires it: slower, weaker. Mix it up! Throw one punch until 2 bars light up.
tutorial.right_after_a_dodge_you: Right after a dodge you glow yellow: your next punch does 1.5x damage. Dodge, then punch.
tutorial.taking_hits_fills_the_stun: Taking hits fills the stun meter. Full = stunned. The dummy is nearly there. Finish it!
tutorial.the_blue_bar_is_stamina: Blue is stamina. At 0 you are exhausted: free punches at half damage, weaker guard and dodge.
tutorial.uppercut_charge_text: Sweet hits charge your Super. Fill all stars, then use Rising Upper: {btn}. It breaks normal guard, but not Perfect Guard. Land one.
tutorial.your_fist_travels_out_too: Your fist travels out. Too close = SOUR (weak); full extension = SWEET. Land a SWEET hit.
